record.paper_title: The Lieb-Thirring inequalities: recent results and open problems
record.original_question: In one dimension, for powers (−Δ)^s with s in (1/2, 3/2), decide whether in the critical case γ = 1 − 1/(2s) the optimal Lieb-Thirring constant equals the corresponding one-particle constant.

evidence.quote: One might wonder whether it is equal to the one-particle constant in d = 1 for s ∈ (1/2, 3/2).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $s\in(1/2,3/2)$ and consider the fractional Laplacian $(-\Delta)^s$ on $\mathbb{R}$. For a real-valued potential $V$ on $\mathbb{R}$ (say $V_-\in L^{\gamma+1/(2s)}(\mathbb{R})$), let $\{\lambda_j(V)\}_{j\ge 1}$ denote the negative eigenvalues of the Schrödinger-type operator $(-\Delta)^s - V(x)$ on $L^2(\mathbb{R})$. The Lieb–Thirring inequality at exponent $\gamma\ge 0$ asserts that there is a finite constant $L_{\gamma,s,1}$ such that
$$\sum_j |\lambda_j(V)|^\gamma \;\le\; L_{\gamma,s,1}\,\int_{\mathbb{R}} V(x)_+^{\gamma+\frac{1}{2s}}\,dx,$$
and one writes $L_{\gamma,s,1}^{\mathrm{opt}}$ for the smallest such constant. Define the one-particle (Weyl-type single eigenvalue) constant
$$L^{(1)}_{\gamma,s,1} \;=\; \sup_{V\not\equiv 0}\;\frac{|\lambda_1(V)|^\gamma}{\int_{\mathbb{R}} V_+^{\gamma+\frac{1}{2s}}\,dx},$$
which by definition satisfies $L^{(1)}_{\gamma,s,1}\le L_{\gamma,s,1}^{\mathrm{opt}}$.

Consider the critical exponent $\gamma = 1 - \tfrac{1}{2s}$. Determine whether
$$L_{\gamma,s,1}^{\mathrm{opt}} \;=\; L^{(1)}_{\gamma,s,1}$$
holds for every $s\in(1/2,3/2)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a recent survey on Lieb–Thirring inequalities. Available literature on fractional/Hardy–Lieb–Thirring bounds (Frank–Lieb–Seiringer and successors) does not provide a resolution of the equality between the optimal constant and the one-particle constant in the critical 1D case for s in (1/2, 3/2). No published proof or counterexample for the entire range was located.

status_evidence.title: The Lieb–Thirring inequalities: Recent results and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems about sharp Lieb-Thirring constants, including the critical fractional one-dimensional case.
status_evidence.claim: The question is explicitly posed as an open problem in this survey.

status_evidence.title: Hardy-Lieb-Thirring inequalities for fractional Schrödinger operators
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes Lieb-Thirring type inequalities for fractional powers of the Laplacian but does not identify the optimal constant with the one-particle constant in the 1D critical case for general s in (1/2,3/2).
status_evidence.claim: Existing fractional Lieb-Thirring results do not settle the equality.
